channel.title: PretzelerFL rides
channel.description: Personal ~25-minute car-ride briefings for PretzelerFL (Tobias / mowgli42, Melbourne FL). Best at 1.5× in Overcast — about 15–18 minutes of wall-clock listening. Home-life picks: stories, focus, curiosity. Not a workplace feed.
channel.author: Tobias / PretzelerFL / mowgli42

rides.title: Ride: The Monkey's Paw (Jacobs)
rides.summary: Classic suspense short — three wishes, one cautionary tale. ~26 min; try 1.5× for a ~17 min Melbourne drive.
rides.description:
A PretzelerFL ride pick: W. W. Jacobs' The Monkey's Paw, read for LibriVox (public domain).

Why this ride: short enough for a local errand at 1.5×, long enough to stay focused. Home-life listening only.

Attribution: LibriVox Short Story Collection 003 — public domain. Source: https://archive.org/details/stories_003_librivox
Original text: W. W. Jacobs (public domain).
